event_name: MOPAR NHRA Las Vegas Nationals powered by Dodge

pairs.note:
Weather conditions: air temperature 58 degrees, relative humidity 59 percent, barometer 29.74 inches,
adjusted altitude 2,822 feet, track temperature 70 degrees.

Stavrinos is 2 - 1 against Bond in prior events and Stavrinos is 1 - 0 against Bond in prior final
rounds. 

Stavrinos with the starting line advantage, but the engine started to let go with a lot of engine
smoke.  Bond chased him down just past half track and never trailed for the win.  Bond wins his
second Wally this season and eighth of his career.  Bond wins JBS Equipment NHRA Pro Mod Drag Racing
Series presented by Elite Motorsports championship.
